mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.0%, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and HOUST (measured by their product) has a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or when both series are above their 50th percentile, SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods identified as late-cycle expansion, INDPRO decline does not lead to negative SPX 20d returns (i.e., returns are positive in > 50% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real sales of durable goods (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising (above its 20-day moving average).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the inflation rate above 2.5% year-over-year signals potential monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE (measured by the product of their deviations from the mean) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or when both conditions are met, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: After a period of Fed rate hikes (post-Fed tightening cycle), a stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals the end of tightening and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-Fed tightening cycle regime, when FEDFUNDS is stable or declining, SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
